name: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc.
summary:
Advanced Energy Industries (AEIS) reported earnings of $2.74 per share on revenue of $574.10 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.20 per share on revenue of $544.33 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $2.40 per share. The company beat expectations by 14.17% while revenue grew 30.03% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects third quarter non-GAAP earnings of $2.75 to $3.25 per share on revenue of $620.0 million to $660.0 million. The current consensus earnings estimate is $2.44 per share on revenue of $567.58 million for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.

Advanced Energy Industries Inc offers power conversion products for direct current, pulsed DC mid-frequency, high voltage, and radio frequency power supplies, matching networks, RF instrumentation, and PCM as well as thermal instrumentation products.
subject: Advanced Energy Industries Beat Expectations
